text: _For-WILLIAMS, referred to the Highlands of Scotland,_ created in bring William's reign, as walls a small town adjoining, called _Maryburg6_, in honour of his queen. It is fixated in herevelthly, on a narrow arm of the les called _Lad Eekl,_ which might really by a very front even the beini-ted to the Wetton tea. For-William is of a triangular form, having two battions, and to capable of admitting a garrition of 800 men, but could not be defended against an attack, as it is commanded by ferternal blisk in the origin-borhood.
